digest.component_or_area: rebar CLI argument parsing and validation
propositions: rebar comment silently stores flag-like tokens (--body-file, --body) as the comment body instead of rejecting them, discarding the intended content and exiting 0
the stored flag token and any surplus positional arguments holding the real value are both lost, compounding the silent failure mode
positional-body commands (create, edit, session-log, comment, tag, untag, archive, set-verify-commands) lack a guard against flag-looking arguments and are vulnerable to the same footgun
the command must reject arguments beginning with - unless preceded by --, and must document the -- escape hatch for values that legitimately start with -
a test must assert rejection of --body-file and --body tokens specifically, since both have occurred in production
the implementation should decide whether to add a real --body-file option or document shell substitution ("$(cat file)") as the idiomatic workaround
